title_dv: ތާވަލް 18.24: ޚިދުމަތުގެ ބާވަތުން އާސަންދައިގެ ދަށުން ކުރެވިފައިވާ ޚަރަދު 2014 - 2024
notes: Note: These expenditures are based on the blocked amount in MVR

The dialysis figure has been updated to breakdown level. As we had implemented Vinavi, services at breakdown level was captured from end of 2019 from all gov providers in the atolls, hence these are captured in details from 2020 onwards. Previous years dialysis is indicated only for dialysis captured as a sublimit
